name: missing-tests-csv-export
title: CSV export shipped without the tests the DoD requires

task.title: CSV export with quoting tests
task.goal: Add CSV export with tests for quoting and commas.
deliverables: RFC 4180 output with a header row
Tests for commas and embedded quotes
definitionOfDone: Tests cover a title with a comma and one with an embedded quote

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/export/index.ts b/src/features/export/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/export/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+export function toCsv(rows: string[][]): string {
+  return rows.map((row) => row.join(',')).join('\r\n')
+}
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'export',
+  register({ slots, store }) {
+    slots.register({
+      id: 'export-csv',
+      slot: 'toolbar',
+      render: () => {
+        const button = document.createElement('button')
+        button.textContent = 'Export CSV'
+        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
+          const rows = [
+            ['id', 'title', 'done', 'createdAt', 'due', 'tags'],
+            ...store.all().map((todo) => [todo.id, todo.title, String(todo.done), todo.createdAt, todo.due ?? '', todo.tags.join(';')]),
+          ]
+          const blob = new Blob([toCsv(rows)], { type: 'text/csv' })
+          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
+          const link = document.createElement('a')
+          link.href = url
+          link.download = 'sky-todo.csv'
+          link.click()
+          URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
+        })
+        return button
+      },
+    })
+  },
+})

expected.referenceFix: Add colocated tests in src/features/export/index.test.ts: one title with a comma, one with an embedded double quote, a newline and the header row. Then re-run bun test.
expected.rationale: The feature works for the happy path but the DoD explicitly requires tests for commas and quotes; no test file was added.
